I answered Marcus in a thread on their message in #north-team: the main contact for the door 6 duplicate arrivals is **Thea Ramaswell**, Director of Yard Operations at Quarrendon Freight Lines.

Both sources are things Marcus can see. In #north-team, Dana posted on Aug 20, 2025 that Thea had flagged the door 6 duplicate arrivals again on the morning shift. The public North team cheat sheet also lists Thea as QFL's main contact.

A contact name is operational information, not a finance figure, so it was fine to post in the team channel.
